name: Markdown
description:
Assistant prose. GFM markdown, sanitised, with Glass UX semantics: internal links to
entities become context chips, external links say they leave Glass UX, `[^n]` markers become
citation pills, fenced code becomes a CodeBlock and tables take the AI table style.
Prose holds the reading measure (in a conversation, the reading column); code and tables
are wide blocks that break out wider than the text.

props.name: anchors
props.description:
Give headings GitHub-style ids (`## R1 · Consistency` → `#r1--consistency`, repeats
suffixed `-1`, `-2`) and render `#fragment` links as in-page links. For documents read at
length; leave it off for messages, where several on one page would repeat ids and a
fragment link has no target. Default false: fragment links render as plain text.

props.name: streaming
props.description: Show the caret after the last character while the answer streams in.

props.name: text
props.description: Assistant markdown (GFM). Raw HTML is ignored and the tree is sanitised.

props.name: wrapTableCells
props.description: Wrap table text within the available column widths and show every row (the page scrolls). Default false uses single-line cells with truncation tooltips and caps long tables in a scroll box; use true for readable documents.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes applied to the outer element for layout. Use the component props and theme tokens for its appearance.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The initial value when using the component without controlling its state.

props.name: ref
props.description:
Allows getting a ref to the component instance.
Once the component unmounts, React will set `ref.current` to `null`
(or call the ref with `null` if you passed a callback ref).
